exposure: mode of birth (natural birth vs. Cesarean section)
cohort: The study included 4,048 neonates, comprising both naturally born and Cesarean section infants.
finding: Preventative massage on the lacrimal sac significantly reduced the incidence of neonatal dacryocystitis.
mod_finding: Incidence of neonatal dacryocystitis was reported separately for natural labor and Cesarean delivery within both the massage and control groups, but no specific finding related to the effect of mode of birth itself was stated.
